verdict.rationale: PagerDuty provides escalation policies, incident workflows with configurable trigger/action logic, and on-call schedules that structure who gets notified and can automate response steps, which loosely supports coordinated response. However, the evidence never mentions explicit incident-commander/comms-lead role designations or built-in task checklists for responders during an incident. Missing for 10: dedicated incident role assignment (commander, comms lead), structured task/checklist templates tied to incidents, and independent confirmation these role/checklist features work as advertised.
